notes.title: Thank you all for your support
notes.notes:
We support everyone who writes to us. If you are a streamer, curator or just a player, write to us with any questions. We are open for cooperation.

The manual has added a walkthrough guide for those who encounter difficulties in the game.

Look forward to more updates and news in the future.
